purpose: Reusable iris and pupil consistency contract for the P7-5.2 character reference set.
camera_contract: Strict front face view with level, equal-size eyes.

eye_specification.shape: matching almond-shaped eyes with a natural interocular distance
eye_specification.iris: dark chestnut brown with a consistent dark limbal ring
eye_specification.pupil: one round black pupil centered inside each iris
eye_specification.catchlight: one small oval white catchlight at the upper viewer-left of each iris
eye_specification.eyelids: visible upper and lower lids with matching eyelash density

reject_conditions: pupil offset, missing pupil, or crossed gaze
different eye sizes or eye heights
extra eye, oversized eye, or distorted face proportion
decision: This specification is approved for front-face reference comparison. It does not by itself approve pose, camera-yaw, expression, or cutscene output.
